messages.subject: PyStan debian package available
parts:
A Debian package for PyStan 2.0.1.3 is available:

https://launchpad.net/~ariddell/+archive/pystan

Using the binary package allows one to skip compiling Stan (which often takes
more than 20 minutes).

For those using Ubuntu 13.10 (saucy) the following commands will install PyStan:

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:ariddell/pystan
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install python3-python # or python-pystan for Python 2.7

Please let me know if you encounter any problems.

Best wishes,

-a
